newsitem.title: POLAND: Kable sees 1997 net profit rising.
newsitem.headline: Kable sees 1997 net profit rising.

text.p: Polish cable maker Kable SA sees its 1997 net profit at a level similar to that in 1995 when it earned 6.4 million zlotys, up from last year's 1.5 million zlotys, Kable's official said on Tuesday.
"The forecast is similar to the 1995 net profit," Znelty, an adviser in the firm's capital department, said.
He said the drop in net profit last year despite increased sales resulted from high copper prices.
Kable's sales amounted to 139 million last year, compared with 122 million zlotys in 1995.
